تنتقلي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِلِي (tantaqilī) /tan.ta.qi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# تُنْتَقَلِي (tuntaqalī) /tun.ta.qa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
